_: prices.json — the one price home for fable-share.py's billed line. List prices only: a proxy for plan accounting, never billing truth, which is why the meter prints token quantities beside every dollar figure. Edit this file to re-price; nothing else in the skill carries a rate.
source: Packaged vendor list-price reference, used as a proxy rather than billing truth. Confirm current vendor rates before quoting costs.
matching: A model id is priced by an exact entry in `ids` first (full-id equality, never a prefix: claude-opus-5-5 starts with claude-opus-5 and must not match it), then by family: the id is lower-cased and the first family name it contains, in the order fable, opus, sonnet, haiku, wins. An id matching neither is a broken premise — the meter prints 'billed: unbilled (<reason>)' and exits 2 — never a guessed or zero price.

fable.source: Input and output are list-price references in the declared units; cache prices derive from input multiplied by the listed factors. Confirm current vendor rates and cache tiers.

conflicts: The packaged Sonnet reference uses the introductory rate. Verify the applicable current rate before quoting a billed estimate.
units: input and output are US dollars per million tokens; the three multipliers apply to the family's input rate, giving $/MTok for cache reads, 5-minute cache writes and 1-hour cache writes.
